caption:
Mr Turtle is a dental hygienist. All day he looks down into patients' mouths, and by the afternoon his neck and shoulders feel heavy and his fingers stiff.

Dental work often means long periods holding a head-down posture, so the neck and shoulder muscles get few breaks. Remedial massage can help tight muscles feel easier, and it works well alongside short breaks and exercise.

Hybi's 1-minute reset: chin tuck 5 seconds × 5, big shoulder rolls × 10, and fist-to-open-hand × 10.

Arm or hand tingling, a weaker grip, or headaches alongside it are worth an assessment. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
